Author: Johnneylee Jack Rollins
Name: XivHud
Punchline: Keep Umbra and the world in view.
Description: A reversible native HUD mode for an Umbra-centered interface. Hides native HUD, nameplates, chat and action bars without rewriting your saved HUD layout. Use the HUD entry in Umbra's server-info widget or /xivhud off to restore. World-space UI is provided by the existing guide, rug and panel plugins.
